mission: Collector v1 S2: About, Methodology and draft Privacy/Terms pages with footer links; Vercel Web Analytics and Sentry (web and API) installed off-by-default, no collector release

impacts.reason: New public pages /about and /methodology (indexable, in sitemap) and draft /privacy and /terms (noindex, visible 'Draft – under review' banner, operator 'Card Pirate', placeholders [CONTACT EMAIL] and [GOVERNING LAW]; owner decisions Q3/Q8). Footer links on every page. Methodology restates docs/market_value.md, market_index.md, INVARIANTS.md and collector_accounts.md: no pricing, Market Index or Market Value change. Static pages, no API reads. Draft legal text is not adopted; approval and removing noindex remain the owner's launch gate.

Vercel Web Analytics (cookieless) mounted only when NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_WEB_ANALYTICS=1; custom events limited to the nine in plan §F2 with properties allowlisted to page_type and release_code; path-only page views, admin/API paths never sent. Sentry (@sentry/nextjs 10.75.0) client/server/error boundary, no-op and CSP unchanged unless NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN is set; sendDefaultPii false, no tracing, replay or session pings; beforeSend scrubs Authorization, cookies, bodies, query strings and user; environment staging, release = build SHA. Admin-session-only /api/admin/observability/sentry-test raises a deliberate test error. Free tiers only (owner Q3). Neither is configured on staging at merge, so behaviour there is unchanged.

API Sentry per plan §A rule 5: sentry-sdk==2.70.0 in services/api/requirements-observability.txt, installed only by deploy/railway/api.Dockerfile (two added lines). app.error_tracking is imported only by app.main, imports sentry_sdk lazily and is a no-op without SENTRY_DSN (unset on staging at merge). send_default_pii False, no locals, bodies, tracing or sessions; before_send scrubs credentials, cookies, queries and user. Admin-token GET /admin/observability/sentry-test raises on purpose (hidden from OpenAPI, writes nothing). No settings.py, app/models/** or requirements.txt change; collector import graph: 0 changed runtime inputs for snkrdunk and yuyutei.

Page render and metadata (noindex and banner on drafts, canonical, sitemap membership), footer links, analytics allowlist/no-PII and page-view scrubbing, Sentry beforeSend scrubbing, no-op without DSN, CSP origin, admin test route auth, API scrubbing/no-op/options, requirements isolation, collector import-graph.
ATLAS tranche contract for the info pages.

resources.name: Staging API (image gains sentry-sdk; inert without SENTRY_DSN)

routes: New: /about, /methodology, /privacy, /terms (static), /api/admin/observability/sentry-test (admin session), API GET /admin/observability/sentry-test (admin token). Footer on every page gains four links. No existing route changes.
impact.deployment_impact: Web builds on merge through the Vercel Git integration. API, worker, beat and market-index-snapshot build through their normal GitHub triggers. No collector watch path or collector-imported module changes, so no collector build or rollout; collector_services is empty. No migration; revision stays 3b7d9c1a5e20.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR (web and API redeploy through their normal triggers). If DSN or analytics variables were added later, removing NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN / NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_WEB_ANALYTICS (Vercel, then redeploy) and SENTRY_DSN (Railway API) switches both off without a revert.
recovery.trigger: verifier failure; any public page error or hydration error; any change in Market Value, Market Index or card/print responses; any collector deployment record after merge
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no database or persistent-state change.

verification.observation_window: Delivery receipt with frontend and API at the merge, revision 3b7d9c1a5e20 and 0 collector deployments (Railway records); /about, /methodology 200 indexable, /privacy and /terms 200 noindex with banner; footer links on every page.
